detail: 1 of 12 factor combinations have no observations, so the interaction terms cannot be estimated. Collect data for the empty combinations, or fit main effects only (no interactions).
'treatment' and 'time' are completely confounded: each level of 'treatment' occurs with exactly one level of 'time', so their effects cannot be separated.
No residual degrees of freedom: 12 observations for 12 identifiable parameters. The error variance cannot be estimated, so F statistics and P values do not exist.
'quantity' has the same value (100) in every row; there is no variation to analyse.

48 rows come from 12 distinct 'colony_id' values; 12 'colony_id' value(s) contribute more than one row. Repeated observations of the same unit are not independent replicates. That needs a mixed-effects model with the unit as a random effect, which MakeMyFigure does not fit. Average to one value per unit and condition, or analyse the full data in dedicated software (e.g. R lme4).
